title: Hard Hat
wikitext: {{Infobox clothing |image = Hard Hat.png |source = [[Adventurer's Guild]] |gprice = {{Price|20000}} |value = Cannot be sold }} The '''Hard Hat''' is a [[Hats|hat]] that can be obtained as a reward from [[Gil]] at the [[Adventurer's Guild]] after completing the [[Adventurer's Guild#Monster Eradication Goals|Monster Eradication Goal]] of killing 30 [[Duggy|Duggies]]. After that, it can be purchased from [[Marlon]] for {{Price|20000}}. It can also be obtained from [[Desert Festival#Emily's Outfit Services|Emily's outfit services]] at the [[Desert Festival]]. Male players have a ≈2% chance to receive the outfit with the Hard Hat. ==Notes== * The Hard Hat outfit also includes the [[File:Shirt256.png|24px|link=]] [[Tailoring#Shirts|Oil Stained Shirt]] and [[File:Relaxed Fit Pants.png|24px|link=]] [[Tailoring#Pants|Relaxed Fit Pants]] (dyed RGB value 99,132,96). ==Bugs== * When the player's character is facing sideways, certain hairstyles cause the hair to be visible at the back of the hat, outside the hat. ==References== Male players have 47 possible outfits (1/47 ≈ 2.13%). See Content\Data\MakeoverOutfits.xnb.
